note: Initial Chromium cordon test reached BUSTED but the subsequent WRECKED UI did not update within the five-second assertion window on the software GPU. Independent reproduction passed. The test now waits for a fresh running frame and allows 45 seconds for the failure UI. Persistent-effect fixtures synchronize wreck animation age with simulation time. Road-only reinforcement filtering and conservative wreck/smoke visibility bounds were then hardened, covered by units, and all six affected pursuit/failure/persistent-effect scenarios were rechecked on the final code.
